items.summary_zh: 该论文提出一个多阶段规则链框架，用于在符号、结构与概念三个层面进行组合式推理，以应对 ARC（抽象与推理语料库）基准所考察的认知泛化能力——即从有限样例中推断并应用抽象规则。框架整合三个互补求解器，其中包含一个确定性规则发现模块，通过几何、颜色与基于对象的分析归纳出原子变换，以及一个模式组合引擎，用于重建输出。整体目标是在有限示例条件下提升推理的组合性与可解释性。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.10654v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The Abstraction and Reasoning Corpus (ARC) benchmarks cognitive generalization, the ability to infer and apply abstract rules from limited examples. This paper presents a multi-stage rule-chaining framework that performs compositional reasoning across symbolic, structural, and conceptual levels. The framework integrates three complementary solvers: (1) a deterministic rule discovery module that induces atomic transformations through geometric, color, and object-based analysis; (2) a pattern-composition engine that reconstructs outputs via block m…
items.why_zh: ARC 是衡量抽象推理与泛化能力的关键基准，该框架将规则发现与组合推理显式化，有助于提升 AI 推理的可解释性。
items.why_en: ARC is a key benchmark for abstract reasoning and generalization, and making rule discovery and composition explicit can improve the interpretability of AI reasoning.

items.title_zh: 理解扩散模型微调中 LoRA 秩的权衡
items.title_en: Understanding LoRA Rank Trade-offs in Diffusion Model Fine-Tuning
items.summary_zh: 该研究针对扩散模型微调时如何在生成质量与算力成本之间选择 LoRA 秩，展开了受控实验：在 CIFAR-10 上使用 DDPM U-Net，秩取 2、4、8、16、32，固定优化设置并采用可复现的本地 pytorch-fid 协议，报告 FID、可训练参数量、运行时间与 GPU 显存占用。作者还通过更长预算的 DDPM 训练以及 Tiny DiT 骨干验证趋势。结果显示中等秩效率最高，其中秩 4 取得最佳 DDPM FID（124.1380）。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.10656v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Selecting LoRA rank for diffusion fine-tuning requires balancing quality and compute cost. We present a controlled study on CIFAR-10 using a DDPM U-Net with ranks {2,4,8,16,32}, fixed optimization settings, and a reproducible local-folder pytorch-fid protocol. We report FID, trainable parameters, runtime, and GPU memory, then validate trends with extended-budget DDPM runs (20 epochs; ranks 4/8/16) and a Tiny DiT backbone (10 epochs; ranks 4/8/16). Results show moderate ranks are most efficient: rank 4 achieves the best DDPM FID (124.1380), rank 8…
items.why_zh: 为扩散模型 LoRA 微调的秩选择提供了可复现的实证依据，帮助研究者在生成质量与算力成本之间做出取舍。
items.why_en: It provides reproducible empirical guidance for choosing LoRA rank in diffusion fine-tuning, helping trade off generation quality against compute cost.

items.title_zh: IMO 金牌的开源配方：为奥数竞赛训练 Nemotron
items.title_en: An Open Recipe for IMO Gold: Training Nemotron for Olympiad Mathematics
items.summary_zh: 该研究考察模型后训练与测试时推理设计如何影响高难度奥赛数学的自然语言证明生成。作者以 Nemotron 3 Ultra 为起点，通过监督微调与强化学习训练两个专家检查点，并评估检查点选择、验证与精修的影响。基于这些发现，他们提出一套开放模型的测试时算力流水线：整个系统完全在自然语言中运行，不使用形式化证明器、外部工具或互联网访问。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.10712v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study how model post-training and test-time inference design affect natural-language proof generation for hard olympiad mathematics. Starting from Nemotron 3 Ultra, we train two specialist checkpoints using supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning, and evaluate checkpoint choice, verification, and refinement. Based on these findings, we present an open-model test-time-compute pipeline. The system operates entirely in natural language, with no formal prover, external tools, or internet access. Three Nemotron 3 Ultra checkpoints - the g…
items.why_zh: 它展示了仅凭自然语言与测试时算力即可冲击奥数级证明，为开源模型的高难推理提供了可复用配方。
items.why_en: It shows that olympiad-level proofs may be achievable with natural language and test-time compute alone, offering a reusable recipe for open models tackling hard reasoning.

items.title_zh: 定义 AI 智能体：标准、指标与基准汇编
items.title_en: Defining AI Agents: A Compendium of Criteria, Metrics, and Benchmarks
items.summary_zh: 论文指出，人工智能领域的“智能体（agent）”一词缺乏统一定义，导致智能体研究在评估、比较与可复现性上面临困难。为回应这一模糊性，作者以五个“智能体性”维度组织综述：环境交互、学习与适应、自主性、目标导向行为以及时间一致性。针对每个维度，他们梳理既有工作中相应能力如何被概念化，并汇总用于评估这些能力的指标、基准与评测框架。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.11018v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The term agent in artificial intelligence lacks a standard definition, complicating the evaluation, comparison, and reproducibility of AI agent research. We address this ambiguity through a survey organized around five dimensions of agenticness: environmental interaction, learning and adaptation, autonomy, goal-directed behavior, and temporal coherence. For each dimension, we examine how the underlying capability has been conceptualized across prior work and synthesize the metrics, benchmarks, and evaluation frameworks used to assess it. This rev…
items.why_zh: 它为混乱的智能体概念提供了统一坐标系，有助于提升评测结果的可比性与研究的可复现性。
items.why_en: It offers a shared frame of reference for a muddled concept, improving comparability of evaluations and reproducibility of agent research.

items.title_zh: KuaiRP 系列角色扮演模型技术报告
items.title_en: KuaiRP Series Role-playing Models Technical Report
items.summary_zh: 该报告介绍了 KuaiRP 系列角色扮演模型的完整技术方案，目标是实现四项核心能力：简化提示工程、输出质量高度稳定、内置领域世界知识，以及在小参数规模下实现高效部署。作者指出，深度注入领域知识往往会导致模型通用智能体能力出现严重的灾难性遗忘。为化解这一权衡，他们提出了一套多阶段训练流水线。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.11127v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: This paper introduces the complete technical solution for the KuaiRP series of role-playing models. We aim to achieve four core objectives for a dedicated role-playing model: simplified prompt engineering, highly stable output quality, built-in domain world knowledge, and high-efficiency deployment with a small parameter size. However, effectively injecting deep domain knowledge often leads to a severe catastrophic forgetting of the model's general agent capabilities. To overcome this trade-off, we propose a multi-stage training pipeline. First,…
items.why_zh: 它直面角色扮演模型“领域知识注入与通用能力遗忘”的核心矛盾，给出了可落地的工程化训练方案。
items.why_en: It confronts the core trade-off between injecting domain knowledge and forgetting general abilities, offering an engineering-oriented training recipe for role-playing models.

items.title_zh: 寡头难以左右多模型生态中的模型崩塌
items.title_en: The Oligarch Barely Steers Model Collapse in Multi-Model Ecosystems
items.summary_zh: 随着 AI 生成文本回流进下一代模型的训练语料，递归训练会引发模型崩塌。近期研究把这一设定扩展到多个模型相互喂食的情形，但几乎都假设市场被均匀分割，而现实的生成式 AI 处于寡头格局。集中化带来两点担忧：来源更少、更同质可能加速崩塌，后出现的模型也可能被拖向寡头的输出。作者在受控生态中用 13 个 1–4B 开源模型组成由 3 到 13 个模型构成的自然生态来检验这两点，标题结论显示寡头几乎无法主导崩塌走向。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.11146v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: AI-generated text is flowing back into the training corpora of the next generation of models. Recursive training on it drives model collapse, and recent work extends the setting to many models feeding one another -- but almost always with the market split evenly, while real generative AI is an oligopoly. Concentration raises two worries: fewer, more uniform sources may make collapse faster, and later models may be dragged toward the oligarch's output. We test both in controlled ecosystems: 13 open 1--4B models form natural ecosystems of 3 to 13 p…
items.why_zh: 它表明市场集中度对模型崩塌的实际影响有限，对合成数据治理与模型生态多样性具有启示意义。
items.why_en: It suggests market concentration has limited effect on collapse dynamics, with implications for synthetic-data governance and ecosystem diversity.

items.title_zh: LLM 能遵循医学专家逻辑吗？偏倚风险评估中的分层逻辑一致性基准
items.title_en: Can LLMs Follow Medical Expert Logic? A Benchmark for Hierarchical Logical Consistency in Risk-of-Bias Assessment
items.summary_zh: 循证医学要求严格的逻辑一致性，但当前对大语言模型的评估更侧重表面标签匹配，而非真正的推理能力。作者提出 LogiMed-RoB，一个以 Cochrane 偏倚风险（RoB）2.0 专家逻辑为基础的基准，包含 860 项随机对照试验（RCT）与 14,820 条查询。它在分层逻辑一致性（HLC）框架下从四个维度评估模型：原子一致性、领域一致性、聚合一致性与证据忠实性。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.11185v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Evidence-based medicine demands strict logical consistency, yet current evaluations of large language models (LLMs) prioritize superficial label matching over genuine reasoning. We introduce LogiMed-RoB, a benchmark grounded in Cochrane Risk of Bias (RoB) 2.0 expert logic, comprising 860 randomized controlled trials (RCTs) and 14,820 queries. It evaluates models under the Hierarchical Logical Consistency (HLC) framework across four dimensions: Atomic Consistency, Domain Consistency, Aggregation Consistency, and Evidential Faithfulness. Experiment…
items.why_zh: 它把医学 AI 评测从“标签是否匹配”推进到“推理逻辑是否自洽”，对高风险医疗决策场景尤为重要。
items.why_en: It moves medical AI evaluation beyond label matching to logical self-consistency, which matters greatly in high-stakes clinical settings.

items.title_zh: 面向智能手术室的语音交互多智能体系统：架构设计与关键技术
items.title_en: A Voice-Interactive Multi-Agent System for Smart Operating Rooms: Architecture Design and Key Technologies
items.summary_zh: 论文提出 SurgicalRoomAgent，一个基于大语言模型的智能手术室语音交互多智能体系统。该系统通过分层架构实现自然语言理解、设备控制、术中记录与手术报告生成，其中包括语音交互流水线（唤醒、ASR、轮次检测、智能体推理、TTS）与智能体核心（技能注册表、任务规划器、设备管理器）。研究还考察了三项关键技术，其中包含用于低延迟推理的 KV Cache 前缀预热。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.11231v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: This paper presents SurgicalRoomAgent, a voice-interactive multi-agent system for smart operating rooms based on large language models (LLMs). The system achieves natural language understanding, device control, intraoperative recording, and surgical report generation through a layered architecture comprising a voice interaction pipeline (wake, ASR, turn detection, agent reasoning, TTS) and an agent core (skill registry, task planner, device manager). Three key technologies are investigated: (1) KV Cache prefix warming for low-latency inference, r…
items.why_zh: 它展示了 LLM 多智能体在手术室这一高要求真实场景中的落地路径与低延迟工程要点。
items.why_en: It illustrates a concrete path for LLM multi-agent systems in the demanding operating-room setting, highlighting low-latency engineering needs.

items.title_zh: NovGauge：诊断大模型论文新颖性评估能力的细粒度基准
items.title_en: NovGauge: A Fine-Grained Benchmark for Diagnosing LLMs' Capability in Paper Novelty Assessment
items.summary_zh: 随着大模型被越来越多地用于各大 AI 会议的同行评审，判断论文“新颖性”始终是其薄弱环节。现有基准通常只给出一个整体性分数，难以诊断模型究竟在哪个维度判断失误，也无法判断其给出的依据是否忠实可靠。为此，研究者提出 NovGauge——一个以人工标注为锚点的细粒度新颖性评估诊断基准。该基准包含来自两个专家来源的 619 组论文对和 50 个多论文集合：一是 ICLR 审稿人之间的重叠主张，二是综述文献的共被引关系。它旨在把新颖性判断拆解为可诊断的维度，帮助定位模型的具体短板。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.11234v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used in peer review at major AI conferences, yet novelty remains a persistent weak point. Existing benchmarks assess novelty as a single holistic score, making it difficult to diagnose which dimension a model misjudges or whether its evidence is faithful. We present NovGauge, a human-anchored benchmark for fine-grained novelty assessment diagnosis. The benchmark contains 619 paper pairs and 50 multi-paper sets, drawn from two expert sources: ICLR reviewer overlap claims and survey co-citations. Instan…
items.why_zh: 它把“新颖性打分”变成可诊断的维度级评估，有助于提升 LLM 辅助同行评审的可靠性。
items.why_en: It turns novelty scoring into a diagnosable, dimension-level evaluation, which could make LLM-assisted peer review more trustworthy.

items.title_zh: 基于 AI 的火炬燃烧效率估算方法
items.title_en: AI-Powered Flare Combustion Efficiency Estimation
items.summary_zh: 在炼化等工业场景中，火炬烟囱保持高燃烧效率，是满足监管标准、控制碳氢化合物排放的关键。传统手段如气体分析仪和高光谱相机价格昂贵、易损且需频繁校准，在偏远或预算受限的工业现场难以落地。研究者提出一种创新方案：将轻量级视觉—语言编码器与紧凑的多层感知机结合，直接由低成本输入预测燃烧效率。该思路有望降低监测门槛，让更多现场具备实时、可持续的排放监测能力。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.11262v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Achieving high combustion efficiency in flare stacks is crucial for adhering to regulatory standards and controlling the release of hydrocarbons into the environment. Traditional instruments like gas analyzers and hyperspectral cameras are expensive, fragile, and require frequent calibration, which makes them impractical for remote or budget constrained industrial sites. We propose an innovative solution that combines a lightweight vision-language encoder with a compact multi-layer perceptron to predict combustion efficiency directly from low-cos…
items.why_zh: 用轻量模型替代昂贵仪器，可让偏远和预算受限的工业现场也能实时监测火炬排放。
items.why_en: Replacing costly instrumentation with a lightweight model could bring real-time flare-emission monitoring to remote and budget-constrained sites.

items.title_zh: 利用机器学习与天气数据预测芬兰列车延误
items.title_en: Predicting Train Delays in Finland Using Machine Learning and Weather Data
items.summary_zh: 铁路可靠运行日益依赖通过无线传感基础设施提供的实时环境信息，而 6G 网络将通过通感一体化与边缘计算显著增强这一能力。在极寒、强降水频发的北极地区，恶劣天气仍是列车延误的主要成因之一。然而，多数预测方法直接使用原始气象数据，未充分利用领域知识进行特征工程。本文针对芬兰铁路场景，研究如何用机器学习结合天气数据预测列车延误，并强调面向领域的信息化特征构建。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.11277v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Reliable railway operations depend increasingly on real-time environmental intelligence delivered through wireless sensor infrastructures, a capability that 6G networks will substantially enhance through integrated sensing and edge computing. Adverse weather, particularly in Arctic regions with extreme temperatures and heavy precipitation, remains a leading cause of train delays, yet most prediction approaches rely on raw meteorological inputs without exploiting domain-informed feature engineering. This paper investigates machine learning for tra…
items.why_zh: 展示如何把天气领域知识与机器学习结合，提升极寒地区铁路延误预测的准确度。
items.why_en: It shows how domain-informed weather features can improve delay prediction for railways in harsh Arctic conditions.

items.title_zh: 文本何时真正提供信息？多模态时间序列预测的信息论指标基准
items.title_en: When Does Text Inform? Benchmarking Information-Theoretic Metrics for Multimodal Time-Series Forecasting
items.summary_zh: 将时间序列与文本标注结合的多模态预测模型，被寄望通过文本语境带来更准确的预测，但一个关键问题尚缺答案：我们如何判断某条文本标注是否真的对预测有贡献？本质上这是一个信息论问题，而要评估信息论指标能否可靠度量标注的预测价值，就需要一个具备真实答案（ground truth）的基准，而目前并不存在这样的基准。为此，作者构建了一个合成时间序列信号，并配套三类标注——其中一类是语义正确的标注。该基准为检验信息论指标的有效性提供了可控的对照环境。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.11282v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Multimodal forecasting models that combine time series with text annotations promise richer prediction through textual context, but how do we know whether a text annotation meaningfully contributes to the forecasters prediction? This is an information-theoretic question, but to evaluate whether information-theoretic metrics can reliably measure the predictive value an annotation provides, a ground truth benchmark is needed, and none currently exist. We create a synthetic time series signal with annotations in three categories: semantically correc…
items.why_zh: 为“文本标注是否真的有用于预测”提供可验证的评测标准，避免多模态模型的虚假增益。
items.why_en: It provides a verifiable testbed for whether text annotations genuinely help forecasting, guarding against illusory multimodal gains.

items.title_zh: 生成一致的企业：多系统业务数据的合成与无参考评估
items.title_en: Generating a Consistent Enterprise: Synthesis and Reference-Free Evaluation of Multi-System Business Data
items.summary_zh: 合成关系型数据通常由在真实数据集上训练的模型生成，并以与真实数据的距离来衡量质量。本文提出一种“两端都不需要真实数据集”的生成器：只要给定行业、公司规模、商业模式、一组业务应用和一个随机种子，它就能生成一个完整的虚构企业。生成内容涵盖员工队伍、客户基础、销售商机、支持工单、通话录音、聊天消息与文档，且彼此之间保持一致。其核心机制是将一张实体图投影到各个业务系统的原生数据结构中，实现跨系统一致性。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.11286v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Synthetic relational data is normally produced by a model trained on a real dataset, and its quality is measured as the distance to that dataset. This paper describes a generator that has no real dataset at either end. Given an industry, a company size, a business model, a set of business applications, and a random seed, it produces a complete fictional enterprise: a workforce, a customer base, sales deals, support tickets, recorded calls, chat messages, and documents, all consistent with one another. One entity graph is projected into the native…
items.why_zh: 无需真实数据即可生成跨系统一致的企业数据，为企业软件测试与隐私合规提供新路径。
items.why_en: Generating coherent enterprise-wide synthetic data without any real dataset could serve software testing and privacy-compliant data needs.

items.title_zh: 韩语 27B 模型响应风格对齐的“脱靶效应”
items.title_en: Off-Target Effects of Response-Style Alignment in a Korean 27B Language Model
items.summary_zh: 研究者对 Qwen3.8-27B 进行了韩语回答风格的后训练，涉及冗长度、列表与 Markdown 使用、语篇结构和语域等方面。随后他们测量了两个训练目标从未涉及的行为：在 KoBBQ 中面对模糊社会问题时是否拒答（该基准的正确答案为 UNKNOWN），以及在证券指导场景中是否出现非被要求的信息披露。结果显示这两种行为都发生了变化，且变化主要体现在模型的“输出策略”上——即多频繁作答、说多少内容。作者还用匹配的目标形式对照组证明，作答倾向取决于训练目标本身。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.11291v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We post-train Qwen3.8-27B for Korean response style -- verbosity, list and markdown usage, discourse structure and register -- and measure two behaviours the objective never targets: abstention on ambiguous social questions in KoBBQ, where the benchmark-correct answer is UNKNOWN, and unprompted disclosure in securities guidance. Both move, and the changes are expressed primarily through the model's emission policy: how often it answers and how much it says. Matched target-form controls show that answer propensity depends on the training target, n…
items.why_zh: 揭示风格对齐会“意外”改变拒答与信息披露行为，提醒对齐工作须评估非目标行为。
items.why_en: It shows style alignment can unintentionally alter abstention and disclosure behaviour, highlighting the need to audit off-target effects.

items.title_zh: Mr.LHDR：面向真实世界长程多模态深度研究智能体的基准
items.title_en: Mr.LHDR: A Benchmark for Multimodal Real-World Long-Horizon Deep Research Agents
items.summary_zh: 深度研究智能体已具备网络搜索、工具调用、多模态证据分析与信息综合等能力，但现有基准主要考察中等长度的探索任务，很少检验智能体能否维持漫长且高度依赖前序结论的研究流程。为此，作者提出 Mr.LHDR（Multimodal real-world Long-Horizon Deep Research），一个覆盖八个类别的基准，用于评估在不可分解、环环相扣的证据链上进行真实世界深度研究的能力。每道题目都构建自一个隐藏的“节点—关系”图，以此控制证据之间的依赖关系。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.11318v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Deep research agents are increasingly capable of web search, tool use, multimodal evidence analysis, and information synthesis. However, existing benchmarks mainly evaluate medium-horizon exploration and rarely test whether agents can sustain long, dependency-heavy research processes. We introduce Mr.LHDR (Multimodal real-world Long-Horizon Deep Research), a benchmark for evaluating real-world deep research over long, irreducible chains of interdependent evidence across eight categories. Each question is constructed from a hidden Node-Relation gr…
items.why_zh: 把评测重点从短程检索转向长程依赖推理，更贴近真实深度研究场景。
items.why_en: It shifts evaluation from short-horizon retrieval to long-horizon, dependency-heavy reasoning that mirrors real research.

items.title_zh: Magenta：打通数学推理与 Lean 形式化验证的闭环
items.title_en: Magenta: Closing the Loop Between Mathematical Reasoning and Lean Verification
items.summary_zh: 数学知识大多以非形式化的自然语言方式传播。大语言模型擅长使用自然语言，因而在非形式化数学推理上表现强劲，但并非完美。把 LLM 限制在非形式化推理中，等于放弃了机器通过可机检证明所提供的离散验证能力。本文通过将 Lean 的验证信号引入其中，弥合非形式化推理与形式化推理之间的鸿沟，形成两者互相增强的闭环。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.11319v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Most of mathematical knowledge has been communicated through so-called informal use of mathematics and natural language. With large language models (LLMs) being highly adept in using natural language, they achieve strong performance, yet not perfect, in informal mathematical reasoning. Restraining LLMs to informal reasoning misses out on the opportunity to use the discrete verification abilities that machines offer through machine-checkable proofs. In this paper, we bridge the gap between informal and formal reasoning by integrating Lean signals…
items.why_zh: 让 Lean 的形式化验证反馈进入 LLM 推理流程，有望提升数学推理的可验证性与可靠性。
items.why_en: Feeding Lean's formal verification back into LLM reasoning could make mathematical reasoning more verifiable and reliable.

items.title_zh: AI 暴露度与 AI 韧性：面向软件及软件型商业模式的二维评估框架
items.title_en: AI Exposure and AI Resilience: A Two-Dimensional Assessment Framework for Software and Software-Based Business Model
items.summary_zh: 论文指出，传统的技术尽职调查主要考察架构、可扩展性、技术债务等技术属性，难以完整反映 AI 如何影响一家公司的价值主张、竞争地位、利润率或客户触达。为此作者提出“AI 暴露度与 AI 韧性”（AI-ER）二维评估框架：暴露度刻画企业因 AI 而被迫变革的压力，韧性衡量其适应与应对的能力。该框架面向软件产品以及建立在软件之上的商业模式，为投资与战略评估提供新的分析维度。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.11321v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Artificial intelligence is changing both software production and the economics of software-based business models. Classical technology due diligence mainly examines technical properties such as architecture, scalability, and technical debt. These criteria do not fully capture how AI can affect a company's value proposition, competitive position, margins, or access to customers. This paper develops Artificial Intelligence Exposure and Resilience (AI-ER) as a two-dimensional assessment framework. AI exposure describes the pressure for change that A…
items.why_zh: 它把 AI 冲击量化为可评估的维度，补充了传统技术尽调长期忽视的盲区。
items.why_en: It turns AI disruption into assessable dimensions, filling a blind spot long ignored by conventional technology due diligence.

items.title_zh: 可移植语义、私有方言：语言模型“细胞”间潜通信中的复用与负迁移
items.title_en: Portable Semantics, Private Dialects: Reuse and Negative Transfer in Latent Communication Between Language-Model Cells
items.summary_zh: 这项伴随研究延续此前“共享基因组语言模型社会”的实验，追问彼此独立训练的模型社会是否能共享同一套潜信息包语言。作者对六个独立训练的模型两两组合、共 30 个有序配对，进行了泄漏受控的因果互操作性审计，考察严格零样本迁移在何处失效，以及继承而来的接口状态对后续学习是有益还是有害。研究还关注在证据可见性受限的条件下，为何可复用、按价值索引的潜包接口更具优势，而唯一表现优异的全局可见模型学到的却是与具体情境纠缠的编码。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.11365v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In shared-genome language-model societies, restricted evidence visibility favors reusable, value-indexed latent packet interfaces, whereas the sole high-performing globally visible model in the parent study learned an episode-entangled code. This companion study asks whether independently trained societies share one packet language, where strict zero-shot transfer fails, and whether inherited interface state helps or harms later learning. First, a leakage-controlled causal interoperability audit over all 30 ordered pairs of six independently trai…
items.why_zh: 它直指多模型系统中通信协议能否自发形成、何时发生负迁移这一关键问题。
items.why_en: It probes whether communication protocols can emerge across separately trained models—and when negative transfer strikes—a key question for interoperable model ecosystems.

items.title_zh: 从查询到叙事：面向知识图谱探索与质量评估的文化遗产数据故事
items.title_en: From Queries to Narratives: Cultural Heritage Data Stories for Knowledge Graph Exploration and Quality Assessment
items.summary_zh: NFDI4Culture-KG 等文化遗产知识图谱包含数百万条关于艺术品、音乐、铭文、历史事件及相关人物与地点的三元组，但许多用户难以发掘其中的知识。SPARQL 虽然可以学习，但写出有意义的查询首先要求深入理解图谱的数据模型，这一投入令不少领域研究者与从业者望而却步；即便已有用户界面，用户通常也需要一个起点和一定引导。论文提出以“数据故事”将查询转化为叙事，既服务于知识图谱探索，也用于数据质量评估。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.11403v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Cultural-heritage KGs such as the NFDI4Culture-KG contain millions of triples about artworks, music, inscriptions, historical events, and the people and places connected to them. For many users, however, discovering this knowledge can be difficult. While SPARQL can be learned, writing meaningful queries first requires an in-depth understanding of the graph's data model, an investment many domain researchers and practitioners are unwilling to make. Even with existing user interfaces, a starting point and some guidance are usually needed, because t…
items.why_zh: 它降低了文化遗产知识图谱的使用门槛，并让探索本身成为质量评估的手段。
items.why_en: It lowers the barrier to using cultural-heritage knowledge graphs and turns exploration itself into a means of quality assessment.

items.title_zh: 让 LLM 充当符号回归中生理合理性的后验审查者：一项由临床医生评估的案例研究
items.title_en: LLMs as Post-hoc Auditors of Physiological Plausibility in Symbolic Regression: A Clinician-Evaluated Case Study
items.summary_zh: 遗传编程及其变体（如语法进化）被广泛用于符号回归，从多变量数据中推导数学表达式。除预测精度外，这类模型的可解释性潜力也备受重视，因为它们能给出输入变量与结果之间的显式方程。然而演化出的模型往往过于复杂或与科学常识不一致，兼顾可解释性与合理性并不容易。本研究探讨大型语言模型能否协助识别此类问题，并开展了由临床医生参与评估的案例研究。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.11431v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Genetic Programming and its variants, such as grammatical evolution, are widely used in Symbolic Regression to derive mathematical expressions from multivariate data. In addition to predictive accuracy, models are appreciated for their potential to provide interpretability, offering explicit equations that relate input variables to outcomes. However, achieving interpretability and plausibility remains challenging, as evolved models may be complex or scientifically inconsistent. In this study, we explore whether Large Language Models, can assist i…
items.why_zh: 若 LLM 能可靠充当合理性审查者，将显著提升科学发现与临床研究中机器学习模型的可信度。
items.why_en: If LLMs can reliably audit plausibility, they could substantially raise trust in machine-learned models used in science and clinical research.

items.title_zh: 面向无人驾驶方程式赛车的轻量级激光雷达锥桶检测框架：基于随机森林
items.title_en: Lightweight LiDAR-Based Cone Detection Framework Using Random Forest for Formula Student Driverless
items.summary_zh: 无人驾驶方程式赛车对可靠、低延迟的感知要求很高，但许多现有流水线依赖深度学习与多传感器融合，往往需要 GPU 加速。本文提出一条仅使用激光雷达、面向 CPU 执行的轻量感知流水线，结合地面去除、基于 IMU 的运动补偿、DBSCAN 聚类与基于几何特征的随机森林分类。通过特征重要性分析，模型输入特征从 12 个缩减到 7 个而性能得以保持，并在 2,371 个标注样本上完成评估。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.11527v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Reliable, low-latency perception is crucial for Formula Student Driverless vehicles, yet many existing pipelines rely on deep learning and multi-sensor fusion, often requiring GPU acceleration. This paper presents a lightweight LiDAR-only perception pipeline tailored for CPU execution, combining ground removal, IMU-based motion compensation, DBSCAN clustering, and geometric feature-based Random Forest classification. Feature importance analysis reduced the model input from 12 to 7 features while preserving performance. Evaluated on 2,371 labeled…
items.why_zh: 它证明在算力受限的赛车上也能获得可靠感知，为轻量化自动驾驶方案提供了实证支撑。
items.why_en: It shows reliable perception is achievable without GPUs or sensor fusion, providing evidence for lightweight autonomous-driving designs.

items.title_zh: 用带逆模型的基于模型的强化学习实现模块化生产系统的分布式优化
items.title_en: Distributed Optimization of Modular Production Systems using Model-based Reinforcement Learning with Inverse Models
items.summary_zh: 论文提出一种面向高度柔性、模块化制造系统的数据驱动自学习控制新方法。作者采用一种新颖的基于模型的强化学习框架，在强化策略的训练中引入近似逆过程模型，从而将执行（动作）动态的学习与状态空间动态的学习解耦，使强化学习仅在任务空间内完成训练。为近似逆模型，作者提出一种轻量级前馈架构并将其集成到框架之中，面向模块化生产系统的分布式优化。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.11615v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: This paper presents a novel approach for data-driven self-learning control of highly flexible, modular manufacturing systems. Specifically, we employ a novel framework for model-based reinforcement learning which introduces approximate inverse process models within the training of reinforcement policies. This approach disentangles the learning of actuation dynamics and the dynamics in state space, resulting in RL-based training solely within the task space. We propose a lightweight feedforward architecture for approximate inverse models and integ…
items.why_zh: 通过解耦动态学习，该方法有望降低工业强化学习的样本与建模成本，推动模块化产线的自主控制。
items.why_en: By decoupling dynamics learning, it could cut the sample and modeling cost of industrial reinforcement learning, advancing autonomous control of modular production lines.

items.title_zh: MAPLE：融合语言与演化的记忆增强规划
items.title_en: MAPLE: Memory-Augmented Planning with Language and Evolution
items.summary_zh: 领域从业者熟悉自身业务约束，却往往缺乏运筹学专业知识或专门支持。基于 LLM 的优化智能体能够把自然语言需求转化为模型或求解器程序，交由成熟的优化工具执行，使优化更加易得。但真实运营是动态的：需求、资源与优先级不断变化，要求更新数据、约束与目标，而以孤立请求为中心的方法难以为既快速又连贯的持续适配提供支持。论文提出 MAPLE——融合语言与演化的记忆增强规划方法，以应对这一挑战。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.11636v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Domain practitioners understand their business constraints but may lack operations-research expertise or dedicated support. LLM-based optimization agents translate natural-language requirements into models or solver programs that established optimization tools can execute. This progress makes optimization more accessible, but real-world operations are dynamic: changing demand, resources, and priorities require updates to data, constraints, and objectives. Methods centered on isolated requests offer limited support for rapid adaptation that preser…
items.why_zh: 它针对 LLM 优化智能体“一次性作答、难以持续适配”的短板，使自动化优化真正适用于不断变化的真实业务。
items.why_en: It targets the weakness of one-shot LLM optimization agents, making automated optimization viable for continuously changing real operations.

items.title_zh: 自主性、社会规范与对齐：迈向自主人工智能体的发展式框架
items.title_en: Autonomy, Social Norms, and Alignment: Towards a Developmental Framework for Autonomous Artificial Agents
items.summary_zh: 近年来，得益于能够泛化并生成复杂输出的大规模模型，人工智能取得了非凡进展。但把这种潜力迁移到具身智能体时暴露出明显局限：最先进的系统依赖既有数据集与人类反馈策略，这些手段虽然强大，却在动态或未知情境中显得不足。要适应环境，智能体必须通过与环境的直接交互获取知识。论文主张借鉴发展式视角，围绕自主性、社会规范与对齐，提出面向自主人工智能体的发展式框架。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.11660v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In recent years, artificial intelligence has made extraordinary progress thanks to large-scale models capable of generalization and the generation of complex outputs. However, transferring this potential into embodied agents reveals a significant limitation: the most advanced systems rely on pre-existing datasets and human feedback strategies that are powerful but insufficient in dynamic or unknown contexts. To adapt, an agent must acquire knowledge through direct interaction with its environment. One strategy to address this challenge involves i…
items.why_zh: 它指出仅靠预训练数据与人类反馈不足以实现真正的自主适应，为具身智能体的能力建设与规范对齐研究指明方向。
items.why_en: It argues that pretraining data and human feedback alone cannot deliver genuine autonomous adaptation, pointing a direction for embodied-agent capability and norm-alignment research.

items.title_zh: 地理空间 AI、Dataverse 元数据与基于地点的政府研究
items.title_en: Geospatial AI, Dataverse Metadata, and the Study of Place-Based Government
items.summary_zh: 哈佛 Dataverse 托管着超过 15 万个研究数据集，但这些数据集所携带的地理信息由上传者以自由文本方式填写，从未被整理成可检索的结构。研究者利用该仓库的公开数据与元数据构建了一个知识图谱，把 102,650 个数据集组织进一个含 215,985 个节点、528,003 条边的网络，将数据集与关键词、出版物、学科、期刊和地点相互关联。其中 43,991 个数据集（42.9%）至少包含一个地理空间字段、地理覆盖范围或地理单元信息。这一结构为基于地点的政府研究提供了可查询的地理数据基础设施。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.11674v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Harvard Dataverse hosts over 150,000 research datasets, but the geographic information those datasets carry is entered as free text by depositors and has never been assembled into a searchable structure. We construct a knowledge graph from the repository's public data and metadata, organizing 102,650 datasets within a 215,985-node network of 528,003 edges linking datasets to keywords, publications, subjects, journals, and locations. Of those datasets, 43,991 (42.9 percent) carry at least one geospatial field, geographic coverage, geographic unit,…
items.why_zh: 把散落的自由文本地理信息转化为可检索的知识图谱，为空间与社会科学研究打开了新的数据入口。
items.why_en: Turning scattered free-text geographic information into a searchable knowledge graph opens a new data gateway for spatial and social science research.

items.title_zh: COBRA-Skills：用上下文老虎机引导智能体技能进化
items.title_en: COBRA-Skills: Contextual Bandit-Guided Evolution for Agent Skill Optimization
items.summary_zh: 大语言模型智能体可以从以往任务经验中提炼出可复用的技能，但现有技能优化方法往往依赖昂贵的执行式评估和大量任务数据。作者提出 COBRA-Skills，把技能优化建模为在动态演化的候选空间上进行的预算受限序列优化。该框架将上下文老虎机引导的优先级排序与有证据支撑的技能进化相结合，有选择地把评估预算分配给更有前景或信息量更大的候选技能。其目标是降低对昂贵执行反馈与大规模任务数据的依赖。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.11682v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents can benefit from reusable skills distilled from prior task experience, yet existing skill optimization methods often rely on costly execution-based evaluation and substantial task data. We introduce \textbf{COBRA-Skills}, an efficient framework that formulates skill optimization as budgeted sequential optimization over a dynamically evolving candidate space. COBRA-Skills couples contextual-bandit-guided prioritization with evidence-grounded skill evolution, selectively allocating evaluations to promising or infor…
items.why_zh: 它把技能优化从“烧算力试错”变成有预算意识的选择性评估，有望显著降低智能体能力迭代的成本。
items.why_en: It reframes skill optimization from brute-force trial-and-error into budget-aware selective evaluation, potentially cutting the cost of agent capability iteration.

items.title_zh: 从参数到答案：大模型如何检索并使用内部知识
items.title_en: From Parameters to Answers: How LLMs Retrieve and Use Their Internal Knowledge
items.summary_zh: 语言模型在回答问题时，对“查询路由信息”和“目标知识”的依赖是如何随层变化的？作者通过在问题末尾的隐藏状态上做逐层干预来研究这一问题，并在 Qwen、Llama 和 Gemma 上比较国家—大洲类问题与名词、形容词、代码类答案的表现，同时保持若干拟合出的测量量彼此区分。文中区分出一种“成对条件请求方向”，用来描述自然单国问题中究竟查询的是哪个国家；以及一种“全局请求方向”，用于刻画第一与第二……等情形。该工作为理解大模型内部知识的检索与使用机制提供了细粒度证据。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.11859v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: How does a language model's dependence on query-routing information and target knowledge change as it answers a question? We study this question through layerwise interventions on the hidden state at the end of the question. Across Qwen, Llama, and Gemma, we compare country-continent questions with noun, adjective, and code answers while keeping several fitted measurements distinct. A pair-conditioned request direction describes which country is queried in natural single-country questions; a global request direction describes first- versus second…
items.why_zh: 逐层揭示大模型何时“找对问题”、何时“取出答案”，对可解释性与知识编辑都有直接价值。
items.why_en: Layer-by-layer evidence on when a model routes the query versus retrieves the answer informs both interpretability and knowledge editing.

items.title_zh: 线性推荐模型的正则化全景：殊途同归的核范数约束
items.title_en: On the Regularization Landscape for the Linear Recommendation Models
items.summary_zh: 近年来，一批受深度学习技术（如 dropout、自编码器）启发的推荐算法在多个标准推荐基准上成为性能领先者。这些算法基于不同的深度学习技术构建，却表现出相近的性能，甚至拥有相似的代价函数。本文追问：这种性能上的接近究竟是巧合，还是它们可以被统一到同一个框架之下。作者发现，所有线性模型中的性能领先者实际上都只额外加入了一种基于核范数（nuclear norm）的正则化。这一发现为理解并统一这些看似各异的推荐算法提供了新的视角。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.11876v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Recently, a wide range of recommendation algorithms inspired by deep learning techniques have emerged as the performance leaders on several standard recommendation benchmarks. While these algorithms were built on different DL techniques (e.g., dropouts, autoencoder), they have similar performance and even similar cost functions. This paper studies whether the models' comparable performance are sheer coincidence, or they can be unified under a single framework. We find that all linear performance leaders effectively add only a nuclear-norm based r…
items.why_zh: 若众多推荐模型可归约为同一正则化项，模型设计将转向更本质的取舍，而非技术堆叠。
items.why_en: If many recommender models reduce to one regularization term, design shifts from technique stacking to more fundamental trade-offs.

items.title_zh: MindTopo：基础模型能在拓扑空间中推理吗？
items.title_en: MindTopo: Can Foundation Models Reason in Topological Space?
items.summary_zh: 空间推理不仅依赖距离、角度、形状等度量性质，也依赖在连续形变下保持不变的各种拓扑关系。认知科学将这些关系视为空间理解的基础，然而当前基础模型的评测大多集中于度量性质或依赖视角的关系。作者提出 MindTopo，一个面向拓扑直觉的基准，涵盖源自认知科学与形式拓扑的五个属性：连续性、分离性、序、包含与纽结。该基准旨在检验基础模型是否真正具备拓扑层面的空间推理能力。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.11900v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Spatial reasoning depends not only on metric properties such as distance, angle, and shape, but also on topological relations that remain invariant under continuous deformation. Cognitive science identifies these relations as foundational to spatial understanding, yet foundation-model evaluations largely focus on metric or viewpoint-dependent relations. We introduce MindTopo, a benchmark of topological intuition across five properties grounded in cognitive science and formal topology: continuity, separation, order, enclosure, and knots. MindTopo…
items.why_zh: 它把评测焦点从“量得准不准”转向“关系理不理解”，补上了空间智能评测的关键缺口。
items.why_en: It shifts evaluation from measurement accuracy to relational understanding, filling a key gap in spatial-intelligence benchmarking.

items.title_zh: 超越已验证答案：用求解器引导的自蒸馏训练运筹学大模型
items.title_en: Beyond Verified Answers: Solver-Informed Self-Distillation for Bootstrapping Operations Research Language Models
items.summary_zh: 现代大语言模型已能把自然语言描述转写为运筹学（OR）建模公式，强化学习与在线自蒸馏等后训练技术进一步提升了这一能力。但作者指出，训练运筹学建模模型仍存在三点局限：其一，训练通常依赖由人类专家或更强模型验证过的合成公式，限制了监督的可扩展性；其二，信用分配要么过于粗糙、要么代价高昂——结果奖励只对整体作答打分。为此，论文提出“求解器引导的自蒸馏”方法，以更可扩展的方式为运筹学语言模型提供训练信号。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.09957v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Modern large language models (LLMs) can translate natural-language descriptions into operations research (OR) formulations. Post-training techniques including reinforcement learning and on-policy self-distillation have further improved this capability. However, three limitations remain in training LLMs for OR formulations. First, training commonly relies on synthetic formulations validated by human experts or stronger models, constraining scalable supervision. Second, credit assignment is either coarse or costly: outcome rewards score an entire…
items.why_zh: 较少依赖人工验证的合成数据与结果级奖励，有望让运筹学建模能力更可规模化地训练。
items.why_en: Reducing reliance on human-verified synthetic data and outcome-level rewards could make OR-formulation training far more scalable.

items.title_zh: 数据高效语言建模：从前沿突破到原则指导的模型改进
items.title_en: Data-Efficient Language Modeling: From Frontier Advancement to Principle-Guided Model Improvement
items.summary_zh: 在有限的文本中学习，要求模型善用上下文、泛化到新输入并保留有用能力。Qiushi Engine 在 BabyLM 2026 Strict-Small 赛道开展了一项长周期、端到端的自主研究计划，语料规模限定在 1000 万词、累计词呈现量 1 亿次以内。整个工作分三个阶段，把前沿突破、原则发现与原则指导下的模型改进串联起来：第一阶段结合紧凑复述、预算再投资与残差增量学习构建出前沿模型；第二阶段则总结出若干规律。该工作展示了在极端数据受限条件下系统化推进语言模型能力的一条路径。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.10702v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Learning from limited text requires models to use context, generalize to new inputs, and retain useful capabilities. Qiushi Engine conducted a long-horizon, end-to-end autonomous research program on BabyLM 2026 Strict-Small, within 10 million corpus words and 100 million cumulative word presentations. Three stages connected frontier advancement, principle discovery, and principle-guided model improvement. Stage I combined compact restatements, budget reinvestment, and residual incremental learning to build a frontier model. Stage II found that…
items.why_zh: 它把“在极小数据下做出前沿模型”本身当作可复现的研究流程，为数据高效训练提供了方法论样本。
items.why_en: It treats frontier modeling under tiny data budgets as a reproducible research process, offering a methodological template for data-efficient training.

items.title_zh: CARTS：面向全容量密钥文本编码的上下文自回归秩转码隐写
items.title_en: CARTS: Contextual Autoregressive Rank Transcoding Steganography for Full-Capacity Keyed Text Encoding
items.summary_zh: 自回归语言模型可以在保持各位置在上下文中秩（rank）信息不变的前提下，把一段载荷文本转换为词元长度完全相同的隐写文本，作者将这一方法形式化为“上下文自回归秩转码隐写”（CARTS）。此前 Norelli 等人的 Calgacus 构造已在实验中展示了这一现象，但一直缺乏形式化的安全性分析。本文首次对 CARTS 给出严格处理：证明其在确定性模型假设下的精确正确性，并引入了一个与秩相关的新构造。该工作为语言模型隐写术补上了理论安全性这一环。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.10744v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Autoregressive language models can be used to transform a payload text into a stegotext of identical token length by preserving per-position rank information across contexts - a methodology we formalize as Contextual Autoregressive Rank Transcoding Steganography (CARTS). While the Calgacus construction of Norelli et al. demonstrated this phenomenon experimentally, no formal security analysis existed. This paper provides the first rigorous treatment of CARTS. We show its exact correctness under deterministic model assumptions, introduce a rank-c…
items.why_zh: 在语言模型隐写从“能跑通”走向“可证明安全”的过程中，这是首个严格的形式化分析。
items.why_en: It is the first rigorous formal analysis in the shift of language-model steganography from feasibility to provable security.

items.title_zh: 多语言只是名义上的？大模型在乌尔都语上的文化与语言短板
items.title_en: Multilingual in Name Only? Cultural and Linguistic Weaknesses of LLMs in Urdu
items.summary_zh: 这项研究聚焦低资源语言场景下多语言大模型的生成可靠性，以乌尔都语为代表性案例，考察模型在故事生成任务中的正确性与可信度。研究者用 GPT-5.1、Qwen-3-Max、DeepSeek-3.1 三个当代模型生成了包含 93 篇故事的数据集 Urdu-Stories，并对其中出现的错误进行人工标注与分类。结果显示，尽管这些模型号称多语言，但在乌尔都语的语法、用词与文化适切性上仍存在系统性问题。该工作为评估低资源语言的生成质量提供了可复用的语料与方法，也提醒使用者不要轻信“多语言”标签。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.10758v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Multilingual large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for open-ended text generation, yet their behaviour in low-resource languages remains poorly understood. In this work, we question how correct and reliable is the generation of multilingual LLMs when used for the task of story generation. We consider Urdu language as a representative low-resource language. We generate Urdu-Stories, a corpus of 93 stories generated using three contemporary LLMs (GPT-5.1, Qwen-3-Max, DeepSeek-3.1). We manually annotate the errors present in them unde…
items.why_zh: 它揭示了大模型“多语言”能力的名不副实，为低资源语言的部署与评估敲响警钟。
items.why_en: It shows that multilingual LLM capability is often nominal, raising red flags for deployment and evaluation in low-resource languages.

items.title_zh: 超越静态保证：量化安全敏感与 LLM 生成 Python 代码的“静态通过、动态失败”缺口
items.title_en: Beyond Static Guarantees: Measuring the Static-Pass Dynamic-Fail Gap in Security-Sensitive and LLM-Generated Python Code
items.summary_zh: 静态分析因其可扩展、可复现且成本低，被广泛用作软件安全闸门，但它无法直接观察运行时的漏洞利用行为。论文指出，依赖对抗性输入、执行上下文或漏洞链式利用的缺陷，可能顺利通过静态检查却在实践中仍可被利用，而“通过静态分析”常被误当作安全证据。作者因此提出衡量“静态通过但动态失败”缺口的方法，并在安全敏感代码与 LLM 生成的 Python 代码上进行评估。该工作提示：仅靠静态门禁来判定 LLM 生成代码的安全性并不可靠。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.10762v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Advances in large language models (LLMs) fuel the quest for scalable methods to assess the security of generated and security-sensitive software. Static analysis is widely adopted as a scalable, reproducible, and inexpensive security gate, but cannot directly observe runtime exploit behaviour. Vulnerabilities dependent on adversarial inputs, execution context, or exploit chaining may evade static checks while remaining exploitable in practice, yet passing static analysis is often treated as evidence of secure behaviour. This paper introduces th…
items.why_zh: 它质疑了以静态分析作为 LLM 生成代码安全门禁的做法，指出被掩盖的运行时风险。
items.why_en: It challenges using static analysis as a security gate for LLM-generated code by exposing hidden runtime exploitability.

items.title_zh: 反事实边缘化：评估模型对干扰变量鲁棒性的新框架
items.title_en: Counterfactual Marginalisation: Framework for Evaluating Robustness to Nuisance Variables
items.summary_zh: 机器学习模型可能在测试集上表现优异，却依赖人口统计学或采集相关的捷径特征。论文提出“反事实（CF）边缘化”作为一种测试时评估流程，用来衡量分类模型对这类干扰变量的鲁棒性。给定一个反事实图像生成器，方法对年龄、性别等干扰父变量进行干预，为每张测试图像生成反事实版本，并在目标干预分布上对预测取平均，从而得到对人口统计效应做边缘化的“干预感知”预测。该框架为诊断并量化模型的捷径依赖提供了可操作的工具。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.10778v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Machine learning models can achieve strong test performance while relying on demographic or acquisition-related shortcuts. We propose counterfactual (CF) marginalisation as a test-time evaluation procedure for assessing robustness of classification models to such variables. Given a CF image generator, we intervene on nuisance parent variables such as age or sex, generate CF versions of each test image, and average predictions over a target intervention distribution. This produces intervention-aware predictions that marginalise demographic effec…
items.why_zh: 它提供了一种在测试时直接暴露并量化模型对人口统计等捷径变量依赖的方法。
items.why_en: It offers a test-time way to expose and quantify a model's reliance on demographic and other shortcut variables.

items.title_zh: 胶带合众则强：计算与合作的协同演化
items.title_en: Tapes Together Strong: The Co-evolution of Computation and Cooperation
items.summary_zh: 合作如何在复杂的智能体系统中演化？以往演化博弈论研究常把社会互动与行为的物理成本隔离开来，以解释个体为何有动机合作；而人工生命模型则多研究自发复制，却未形式化“获取资源”与“保存共享能量以繁殖”之间的两难。本文提出“自创生博弈论”（Autopoietic Game Theory），在一个计算模型中让社会互动、复制机制及其相关成本彼此耦合、共同演化。该模型把博弈论与人工生命两条传统连接起来，为理解智能体系统中合作的涌现提供了新框架。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.10817v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: How does cooperation evolve in complex agentic systems? Prior work in evolutionary game theory studies why individuals are incentivized to cooperate by isolating social interactions from the physical costs of behavior, while artificial life models traditionally study emergent self-replication without formalizing the dilemma between acquiring resources and preserving the shared energy needed to reproduce. In contrast, we introduce Autopoietic Game Theory, a computational model where social interactions, replication mechanisms, and their associat…
items.why_zh: 它把博弈论与人工生命结合，为智能体系统中合作的涌现提供新的形式化视角。
items.why_en: It connects game theory with artificial life to formalise how cooperation emerges in agentic systems.

items.title_zh: 我们真的在做小样本学习吗？对预训练假设的批判性审视
items.title_en: Are We Really Doing Few-Shot Learning? A Critical Examination of Pre-Training Assumptions
items.summary_zh: 小样本学习通常在一个大规模辅助集上预训练模型，该辅助集的类别与目标任务回合不相交，但来自同一视觉域。本文追问：这样的评测协议是否真的反映了低数据学习？研究者在八个数据集、三种小样本架构和多种 way-shot 设置下，系统比较了无预训练、类不相交的同域预训练、有监督的跨域预训练以及无标签的跨域预训练。结果显示，当前协议中的同域类不相交预训练会显著抬高表现，因而可能夸大了模型在真正低数据条件下的能力。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.10851v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Few-shot learning is commonly evaluated under protocols that pre-train a model on a large auxiliary set whose classes are disjoint from the target episodes yet drawn from the same visual domain. This paper examines whether such protocols truly reflect low-data learning. We systematically compare no pre-training, class-disjoint in-domain pre-training, supervised out-of-domain pre-training, and label-free out-of-domain pre-training across eight datasets, three few-shot architectures, and multiple way-shot settings. Our results show that class dis…
items.why_zh: 它指出小样本学习的常见评测协议可能高估了模型在真实低数据场景下的能力。
items.why_en: It warns that common few-shot evaluation protocols may overstate real low-data capability.

items.title_zh: ReactHuman：面向具身多模态大模型的物理基础类人反应式决策基准
items.title_en: ReactHuman: A Physics-Grounded Benchmark for Human-Like Reactive Decision-Making in Embodied Multimodal LLMs
items.summary_zh: 对突发物理危险做出反应（如接住滑落的盘子、躲开掉落的刀）既是具身智能的重要考验，也是把多模态大模型用作家用机器人决策核心的硬性要求。然而现有评测要么通过视频问答被动考察直观物理，要么聚焦导航、整理等长时程的深思熟虑型任务，没有一项衡量模型能否把物理理解转化为即时的、安全攸关的行动。为此，作者提出 ReactHuman 基准，专门评估具身多模态大模型在物理情境下的类人反应式决策能力。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.10895v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Reacting to sudden physical hazards (catching a slipping plate, dodging a falling knife) is both a meaningful test of embodied intelligence and a hard requirement for deploying multimodal large language models (MLLMs) as the decision coreof household robots. Existing evaluations, however, probe intuitive physics passively through question answering over videos, or target deliberate, long-horizon tasks such as navigation and rearrangement; none measure whether a model can turn physical understanding into immediate, safety-critical action. We int…
items.why_zh: 它填补了具身多模态模型在安全攸关的即时物理反应能力上缺乏评测的空白。
items.why_en: It fills a gap in evaluating embodied multimodal models on immediate, safety-critical physical reactions.
